\section{Main result}
% \begin{lemma}\label{lem:commented} This lemma is commented out. \end{lemma}
\begin{theorem}[Main]\label{thm:main}
Every nonzero $p \in \F[x]$ of degree $d$ has at most $d$ roots; 100\% of the time.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
By Lemma~\ref{lem:roots} and Definition~\ref{def:poly}, and by \eqref{eq:deg}.
See also Section~\ref{sec:prelim}.
\end{proof}
